missing_features: Authentication/authorization middleware on all routes — no auth checks on tickets, customers, services, technicians, rooms, reviews, or dashboard endpoints
Input validation/sanitization — no schema validation (e.g., Zod/Joi) on any req.body or req.query parameters
Pagination — list endpoints use LIMIT without OFFSET, making it impossible to paginate large datasets
Payment gateway integration — only 'cash' and 'balance' methods, no Alipay/WeChat/card support
Invoice/receipt generation — no billing or invoice endpoints
Appointment/booking system — no scheduling or reservation management
Staff scheduling/shift management — no calendar or shift views for technicians
Inventory management — no product, material, or consumable tracking
Expense tracking and financial reporting — no cost/revenue analytics endpoints
Data export functionality — no CSV/PDF export for tickets, customers, or reports
Audit log viewing endpoint — audit_logs table written but no API to query it
Notification history/endpoint — notifications sent but no API to list or manage them
Customer self-service portal — no public-facing booking or profile management
Discount/coupon/promotion system — no discount codes or promotional pricing
Loyalty points system beyond balance — no separate points accrual or redemption
Ticket edit/update endpoint — cannot modify ticket details after creation (no PATCH/PUT on /api/tickets/:id)
Ticket DELETE endpoint — no hard delete or archive capability
Customer DELETE/archive endpoint — no way to remove customers
Service GET by ID endpoint — no /api/services/:id
Technician DELETE endpoint — no way to remove inactive technicians
Room DELETE endpoint — no way to remove rooms
Review EDIT/DELETE endpoint — customers cannot modify or delete their reviews
Review verification — no check that the customer actually used the ticket/service
AI chat streaming (SSE) — all AI responses returned synchronously, no streaming
Date range filtering on dashboard — only shows today's data, no historical view
Rate limiting on all endpoints — no throttling to prevent abuse
CORS configuration — no visible CORS middleware setup
Session/token management endpoints — no refresh token, logout, or session listing
Two-factor authentication (2FA/MFA) — not implemented
Customer self-registration — no public signup endpoint
Soft delete for tickets, customers, services, technicians, rooms — only reviews have implicit soft delete via active flags
Image/photo upload support — no avatar, room photo, or review photo endpoints
Multi-language/i18n support
Data privacy/GDPR endpoints — no data export or deletion requests
SMS/email notification templates management
Offline mode / local caching support
Report generation (financial, sales, employee performance)
Role-based fine-grained permissions beyond admin check — no per-feature access control
performance_issues: No pagination on list endpoints — all list routes use LIMIT without OFFSET, causing memory issues on large datasets
Dashboard endpoint executes 3 separate database queries instead of a single combined query or batched approach
AI chat endpoint loads ALL today's tickets into memory with db.prepare().all() then filters in JavaScript instead of using SQL WHERE
AI score-technicians endpoint loops sequentially through all technicians with individual DB queries — could be parallelized with Promise.all
getTicketWithJoins performs 4 LEFT JOINs on every ticket fetch including the list view, with no selective column fetching
LIKE queries on customer search use leading wildcards (LIKE '%q%') which prevent index usage and are slow on large tables
No query result caching — every request hits the database even for frequently accessed data (e.g., service lists, room lists)
No database connection pooling configuration visible
Reviews endpoint runs COUNT(*) and AVG() aggregate queries on every submission to update technician stats — could be batched or cached
Today dashboard queries scan all tickets with date comparisons and no index-optimized approach
wallet_transactions query returns last 200 but no pagination or cursor-based approach
AI chat context construction fetches all technicians and all tickets every request, inflating payload and processing time
No lazy loading or selective field fetching in JOIN queries — always SELECT *
Sequential loop in aiScoreTechnicians with individual DB queries per technician creates O(n) latency
security_gaps: No authentication/authorization on ANY route — all endpoints assume req.user exists but no verification middleware is present
No rate limiting on login, password reset, API creation, or any endpoint — vulnerable to brute force and abuse
No input validation/sanitization — all endpoints accept arbitrary req.body/req.query values with no schema validation, enabling injection attacks
Raw SQL query construction with string concatenation (though parameterized) — SQL injection risk if query building logic changes
No CSRF protection — POST/PUT/DELETE endpoints have no CSRF token validation
No CORS configuration — unknown origin policy for cross-origin requests
AI config endpoint (/api/ai/config POST) has no auth — anyone can change AI provider settings and API keys
AI chat endpoint accepts arbitrary user messages with no prompt injection filtering or content sanitization
Password minimum length is only 4 characters — extremely weak password policy
Sensitive configuration (AI API keys, hermesUrl) potentially exposed through /api/ai/config GET response
No HTTPS enforcement — no security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options) visible in route configuration
No session management or token expiration — no refresh/revoke mechanism
No IP-based access control or geo-restriction
Audit logs are written but never exposed for review — no audit trail visibility
No request size limiting — potential denial-of-service via large payloads
No file upload validation — if file uploads are added later, no virus scanning or type checking
Review submission has no customer verification — anyone can submit reviews for any technician without proving they used the service
No data encryption at rest for sensitive fields (e.g., customer phone numbers, payment info)
No error message sanitization — some errors may leak internal database or system details
No security headers (Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, etc.)
No request logging or monitoring system visible
No Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules or middleware
code_quality_issues: Inconsistent error handling — some routes use try/catch (e.g., ai.js), others let errors propagate (e.g., tickets.js create)
Inconsistent response format — some endpoints return the object directly, others wrap in { ok: true }, others return arrays
Missing null checks on req.body in multiple places — accessing req.body fields without verifying it exists first in several routes
Repeated startOfDay helper function duplicated across tickets.js, technicians.js, dashboard.js, and ai.js
Hardcoded limit values (e.g., limit=200, limit=50) without configurable defaults or max caps in some endpoints
No logging framework integrated — console.log or structured logging absent
No unit tests visible for any route handler
Magic numbers throughout (e.g., commission_value * 10000 divisor, balance checks) without named constants
Unreachable code after reply.send() in some routes — the transaction() call may not execute if reply already sent
Inconsistent ID generation using nanoid with varying lengths (10 vs 12) across different entity types
No TypeScript or JSDoc annotations — all code is plain JavaScript without type safety
Nested callback patterns and inconsistent async/await usage
Missing HTTP status codes on several endpoints — some error paths return 200 with error field instead of proper 4xx codes
No centralized error handling middleware
Wallet transaction insert uses nanoid(12) but other inserts use nanoid(10) — inconsistent IDs
No database migration or schema validation — routes assume tables exist without checking
Customer topup endpoint broadcasts to all clients but doesn't return transaction details consistently
ChangeStatus function in tickets.js returns ticket data without awaiting broadcast completion
No environment-specific configuration (dev/staging/prod) visible
Hardcoded shop_id from req.user without validation that the shop exists or user belongs to it
No input type checking — e.g., amount_cents passed to arithmetic without verifying it's a number
